# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.1

This prerelease delivers the currently implemented 2.0 work for evaluation. It includes the Express authentication/API backend, scoped system and teaching administration, audit logs, inherited teaching roles, course progress gap hints, and occurrence roster/report reliability improvements since v1.8.1.

## Fixed before release

- School history edits send writable fields only, excluding record IDs and timestamps.
- Blank school dates are sent as `null`, allowing an enrolled student to have no end date and allowing an existing end date to be cleared. Unspecified PATCH dates remain unchanged.
- API validation still rejects read-only fields and malformed dates.
- Fixed frontend container startup by expanding the API proxy configuration in the Nginx bootstrap.

## Images and deployment prerequisites

- Frontend: `ghcr.io/kenny1203520/edulog:2.0.0-alpha.1`
- API: `ghcr.io/kenny1203520/edulog-api:2.0.0-alpha.1`
- Alpha images do not update `latest`, `2`, or `2.0`. Use matching explicit versions for both services.
- This release does not deploy or migrate the existing production environment.
- Before using this version with an existing database, back it up and apply every unapplied migration in filename order through `1000115_report_occurrence_authoritative_roster.sql`. The chain includes suffixed compatibility migrations; do not skip them. Fresh installations require the full chain.
- Follow `docs/deployment/frontend-api-bff.md` for the Nginx/API deployment configuration. Use API v1, server-only Supabase credentials, a cookie secret, explicit allowed origins, and the shared Supabase rate-limit store.
- Returning to an older image does not reverse schema migrations. Verify restoration against a backup before planning a downgrade.

## Known limitations and follow-up

- Alpha evaluation release; the final 2.0 feature set is still being completed.
- OAuth callback routes and a Storage proxy are unavailable and have no enabled application entrypoints.
- The untracked `extension/` workspace is not included in this release.
- Track the remaining work and promotion criteria in `docs/deployment/alpha-roadmap.md`. Future batches use `2.0.0-alpha.2`, `.3`, and so on; published tags are immutable.

## Verification

- Frontend: 476 tests passed; production typecheck/build passed.
- API: 180 tests passed, including HTTP authentication and WebSocket integration; typecheck/build passed.
- Deno API typechecks and 106 contract/security tests passed.
- Existing PostgreSQL clean-install, migration replay, upgrade, and RLS checks passed in an isolated database.
- Both container images passed startup, health, Nginx API proxy, runtime configuration, and unauthenticated access checks.
- Changed GitHub Actions workflows passed actionlint. A deployed evaluation environment with real user data remains part of stable promotion criteria.
